notes: This case deliberately runs no cloud_agreement. A dense reference surface in the same frame would see the scale too; the point being made is that the sparse named check catches it when no such surface exists, which is the situation this repository is actually in.
what: Named lengths and landmarks of a reconstruction 2% larger than the truth.
why: A uniform scale is invisible to held-out closure, to plane roughness and to every other check computed inside the reconstruction's own coordinate system, because a larger world is perfectly self-consistent in it. Sparse named truth from outside that system is what catches it.
